INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES – April 7, 2021

The Inglewood Library Board met on April 7, 2021 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 5:17 p.m. by
Board Member Pat Douglas.

Roll Call

Present:
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Public Comments

  None

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh asked the board to discuss the New Logo for Inglewood Public
Library. Mr. Singh presented 2 different versions, explained and asked their opinion.

  Board Member Cochran made a motion for the approval of the second logo as our Library Logo, the one
with the italic type “I” and the sunrise. Board Member Douglas seconded the motion. Motion was approved as
follows:

  Ayes: Library Board Members Douglas, Cochran and Castillo
  Nays: None

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  All Board Members were very happy and thanked Mr. Singh for doing a terrific job.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 5:27 p.m.
